name: complaint-portal
description: Finance Division IT Complaint Portal — NestJS + Prisma backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: npm run start:dev --workspace=apps/backend & npm run dev --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.start: npm run start:prod --workspace=apps/backend & npm run start --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/frontend
